last_debrief:
STORY SO FAR: Sat 08-08 evening, table rehearsal — and the format flip worked. FIELD MISSION LANDED AGAIN: the -om tail fired in the real room ('ama ponom'), organic slot, no setup. frame:we-om is confirmed live now, not just in chat. He reported it as 'I've got -om cold, we past tense' — I corrected the frame's SCOPE for him: -om is a we-machine, not a past thing (poren -> porom, iruppen -> iruppom, and he already owns iruppom without knowing it).

THE CATCH-CLOSING ESCALATION, ANSWERED BY A FORMAT FLIP. The slip was comprehension-side: he decodes the middle of an exchange, misses where it LANDS, and answers in English. Instead of another tape I flipped it to PRODUCTION — maami mask at her table, full speed, his job to land the close in Tamil. He closed every beat. 'podhum podhum' then 'vendaam, vayiru full', unaided, and correctly LADDERED: podhum stops the ladle, vendaam refuses the offer — he built that escalation himself, most people get it backwards. Then the turn-around close 'neenga saapitteengala?' fired cold and ended the standoff (got the maami to sit down, which is the real win of that scene). I am deliberately NOT marking catch-closing landed: I named the ask in the prompt ('land the close in Tamil'), so it was not unaided in the sense that matters. The honest test is an ambush where nothing tells him a close is wanted. M84 (phone_call, three endings) is still in the tank unlistened — do NOT build another dose for this.

UPGRADES GIVEN: vayiru full -> vayiru nerainjiduchu (the -uchu it-tail he closed Thursday; the stomach did it, not him — unarguable, and it never reads as rejecting her cooking). vendaam + the -mma softener. neengalum saapidunga plus the -um clitic (also/too, bolts onto anything), and ukkarunga FIRST because she will not eat standing.

NEW SLIP — person-marker, and it is a machine, not a word. Asked to say he must call his maama he produced 'naan maama sollanum'. The tail is perfect (obligation -anum on a verb he picked himself) but the human sits there unmarked and the verb defaulted to sollu. Recast both roads — maama-kitta pesanum / maama-va kuppidanum — and he rebuilt 'maama-kitta pesanum'. Hinted, not cold. Commissioned as a story dose: one errand, three people, the marked human audible in every beat.

CORRECTION PAID at the open: catch is 3/12, not the 4/12 I mis-narrated Thursday. Said it before building anything on top of it.

TONIGHT'S MISSION: kai kazhuvittu varen — taught at close, get up from the dinner table with it out loud in front of her. Guaranteed slot, happens every night, no waiting for a moment.

STILL OPEN, never slotted: puriyala-for-reopen (he owns the word's shape, not its conversational job). Volley frozen at 2/4 (KF-14). One ask per message is the house rule. Boot fast, no ceremony — the 08-05 friction still stands. 4 days to touchdown; delight is 3 cold of 27 and pirandhanaal vaazhthukkal is still untouched with amma's birthday ~Aug 24.

soak_order.focus: the person-marker tails on humans — -kitta and -va. Every beat must aim a verb at a NAMED human and let the tail be audible: maama-kitta pesanum, akka-va kuppitten, avanga-kitta sollitten, thangachi-kku anuppunen. Permute one errand across three people so the verb and the tail both change while the marked human is always there. He drops the marker entirely and defaults every verb to sollu — make the unmarked version sound wrong by never once producing it.
